tr.about: Uzun baş üstü asılmayla kavrama dayanıklılığı kazandırır ve omuzları rahatlatır.
steps: Barfiks barını eller yaklaşık omuz genişliğinde olacak şekilde kavra.
Ayaklarını kaldır ve kollar tamamen düz şekilde asıl.
Karnını hafifçe sık ve düzenli nefes al.
Hedef süre boyunca tut, sonra kontrollü in.
cues: Barı baştan sona sıkıca kavra.
Omuzlar gerilsin ama tamamen gevşeme.
Sabit kal; sallanma.

mistakes.text: Asılmayı kolaylaştırmak için kolları bükmek.
mistakes.fix: Asılma boyunca kollarını tamamen düz tut.

mistakes.text: Asılırken nefesi tutmak.
mistakes.fix: Karnını hafifçe sık ve düzenli nefes al.

ar.title: Dead Hang
ar.about: يبني تحمّل القبضة ويريح الكتفين عبر تعلق طويل فوق الرأس.
steps: أمسك العقلة واليدان بعرض الكتفين تقريبًا.
ارفع قدميك وتعلّق والذراعان مستقيمتان تمامًا.
شدّ بطنك قليلًا وتنفس بانتظام.
اثبت للمدة المستهدفة ثم انزل بتحكم.
cues: اعصر البار بقوة طوال الوقت.
دع الكتفين يتمددان دون ارتخاء تام.
ابقَ ثابتًا دون تأرجح.

mistakes.text: ثني الذراعين لتسهيل التعلق.
mistakes.fix: أبقِ ذراعيك مستقيمتين تمامًا طوال التعلق.

mistakes.text: حبس النفس أثناء التعلق.
mistakes.fix: شدّ بطنك قليلًا وتنفس بانتظام.

1-arm-dumbbell-kelso-shrug.en: Single arm: train one side at a time for better focus and a stable torso.
1-arm-dumbbell-kelso-shrug.tr: Tek kol: daha iyi odak ve sabit gövde için her seferinde tek tarafı çalıştır.
1-arm-dumbbell-kelso-shrug.ar: ذراع واحدة: درّب جانبًا واحدًا في كل مرة لتركيز أفضل وجذع ثابت.

angled-dumbbell-drags-garage-program.en: Dumbbells angled slightly, dragged up close to the body with elbows leading out wide.
angled-dumbbell-drags-garage-program.tr: Dumbbell'lar hafif açılı, dirsekler geniş öncülük ederken vücuda yakın yukarı sürüklenir.
angled-dumbbell-drags-garage-program.ar: الدمبلز مائلة قليلًا وتُسحب للأعلى قرب الجسم والمرفقان يقودان للخارج.

arnold-rotations-slight-incline.en: Done on a slight incline bench for back support and a bit more stretch.
arnold-rotations-slight-incline.tr: Sırt desteği ve biraz daha gerilme için hafif eğimli sehpada yapılır.
arnold-rotations-slight-incline.ar: تُنفّذ على مقعد مائل قليلًا لدعم الظهر وتمدد أكبر قليلًا.

around-the-world-rear-delt.en: Standing version: raise out to the sides, then continue overhead in a slow arc.
around-the-world-rear-delt.tr: Ayakta versiyon: yanlara kaldır, sonra yavaş bir yayla baş üstüne devam et.
around-the-world-rear-delt.ar: نسخة الوقوف: ارفع جانبًا ثم أكمل فوق الرأس في قوس بطيء.

barbell-rear-delt-raise.en: Barbell: hinge over and raise a wide-grip barbell with straight arms.
barbell-rear-delt-raise.tr: Barbell: öne eğil ve geniş tutuşlu barı düz kollarla kaldır.
barbell-rear-delt-raise.ar: باربل: انحنِ وارفع البار بقبضة واسعة وذراعين مستقيمتين.

barbell-row-mechanical-drop-end-form-cop.en: Mechanical drop: switch to a stronger body position at failure instead of lowering the weight.
barbell-row-mechanical-drop-end-form-cop.tr: Mechanical drop: tükenişte ağırlığı azaltmak yerine daha güçlü bir pozisyona geç.
barbell-row-mechanical-drop-end-form-cop.ar: Mechanical drop: عند الفشل انتقل إلى وضعية أقوى بدل تخفيف الوزن.

barbell-shoulder-press-45-degree.en: Pressed on a 45-degree bench, which shifts some work toward the upper chest.
barbell-shoulder-press-45-degree.tr: 45 derece sehpada yapılır; işin bir kısmı üst göğse kayar.
barbell-shoulder-press-45-degree.ar: يُنفّذ على مقعد 45 درجة، ما ينقل جزءًا من العمل نحو أعلى الصدر.

barbell-shrug-drops-garage-program.en: Drop set: at failure, reduce the weight immediately and keep going without rest.
barbell-shrug-drops-garage-program.tr: Drop set: tükenişte ağırlığı hemen azalt ve dinlenmeden devam et.
barbell-shrug-drops-garage-program.ar: Drop set: عند الفشل خفّف الوزن فورًا واستمر دون راحة.

barbell-shrugs-wide-grip-garage-2-0.en: Wide grip: hands outside shoulder width, which feels natural for many and frees the shoulders.
barbell-shrugs-wide-grip-garage-2-0.tr: Geniş tutuş: eller omuz genişliğinin dışında; çoğu kişiye doğal gelir ve omuzları rahatlatır.
barbell-shrugs-wide-grip-garage-2-0.ar: قبضة واسعة: اليدان أوسع من الكتفين، وهي مريحة للكثيرين وتحرر حركة الكتف.

bent-dumbbell-shrugs.en: Bent forward at the hips instead of lying on a bench.
bent-dumbbell-shrugs.tr: Sehpaya uzanmak yerine kalçadan öne eğilerek yapılır.
bent-dumbbell-shrugs.ar: انحناء للأمام من الوركين بدل الاستلقاء على مقعد.

bent-over-rear-delts-partials-full-rom-g.en: Combine full-range reps with stretched-position partials in the same set.
bent-over-rear-delts-partials-full-rom-g.tr: Aynı sette tam açıklıklı tekrarları gerilmiş pozisyondaki partials ile birleştir.
bent-over-rear-delts-partials-full-rom-g.ar: ادمج تكرارات بالمدى الكامل مع تكرارات جزئية في وضع التمدد ضمن المجموعة نفسها.

bent-single-arm-supinated-rear-delt-rais.en: Single arm with palm turned forward (supinated), which can improve rear-delt focus.
bent-single-arm-supinated-rear-delt-rais.tr: Avuç öne dönük (supinasyon) tek kol; arka omuz odağını artırabilir.
bent-single-arm-supinated-rear-delt-rais.ar: ذراع واحدة والراحة متجهة للأمام (قبضة سفلية)، ما قد يحسّن التركيز على الدالية الخلفية.

bus-driver-incline.en: Done lying chest-down on an incline bench so the torso cannot cheat.
bus-driver-incline.tr: Gövde hile yapamasın diye eğimli sehpaya göğüs üstü uzanarak yapılır.
bus-driver-incline.ar: تُنفّذ مستلقيًا على صدرك فوق مقعد مائل فلا يستطيع الجذع الغش.

bus-drivers-super-slow-garage-program.en: Slow tempo: use roughly 3–4 seconds up and down to maximize time under tension.
bus-drivers-super-slow-garage-program.tr: Yavaş tempo: gerilim altındaki süreyi artırmak için iniş ve çıkışı yaklaşık 3–4 saniye yap.
bus-drivers-super-slow-garage-program.ar: إيقاع بطيء: خذ نحو 3–4 ثوانٍ صعودًا ونزولًا لزيادة زمن الشد.

cable-rear-delt-close-to-body-copy.en: Lying on an incline bench removes momentum and keeps tension in the stretched position.
cable-rear-delt-close-to-body-copy.tr: Eğimli sehpaya uzanmak momentumu ortadan kaldırır ve gerilimi gerilmiş pozisyonda tutar.
cable-rear-delt-close-to-body-copy.ar: الاستلقاء على مقعد مائل يلغي الزخم ويبقي الشد في وضع التمدد.

cable-side-lateral-single-arm-behind-the.en: Run the cable behind your back for a deeper stretch at the bottom.
cable-side-lateral-single-arm-behind-the.tr: Daha derin alt gerilme için kabloyu sırtının arkasından geçir.
cable-side-lateral-single-arm-behind-the.ar: مرّر الكابل خلف ظهرك لتمدد أعمق في الأسفل.

cable-side-laterals-45-degree-scap-plane.en: Scapular plane: move about 30 degrees in front of the body, a natural, shoulder-friendly path.
cable-side-laterals-45-degree-scap-plane.tr: Scapular plane: vücudun yaklaşık 30 derece önünde hareket et; doğal ve omuz dostu bir yol.
cable-side-laterals-45-degree-scap-plane.ar: مستوى لوح الكتف: تحرك بزاوية نحو 30 درجة أمام الجسم، وهو مسار طبيعي ومريح للكتف.

cable-straight-bar-wrist-curls.en: Cable version keeps tension at the bottom stretch.
cable-straight-bar-wrist-curls.tr: Kablo versiyonu alttaki gerilmede gerilimi korur.
cable-straight-bar-wrist-curls.ar: نسخة الكابل تحافظ على الشد في التمدد السفلي.

cable-straight-bar-wrist-extensions.en: Cable version keeps tension at the bottom stretch.
cable-straight-bar-wrist-extensions.tr: Kablo versiyonu alttaki gerilmede gerilimi korur.
cable-straight-bar-wrist-extensions.ar: نسخة الكابل تحافظ على الشد في التمدد السفلي.

dead-hang-ryan_humis514743.en: Target: hold for 60 seconds, accumulating time if needed.
dead-hang-ryan_humis514743.tr: Hedef: 60 saniye tut, gerekirse süreyi parça parça biriktir.
dead-hang-ryan_humis514743.ar: الهدف: الثبات 60 ثانية، مع تجميع الوقت على دفعات عند الحاجة.

decline-dumbbell-press-copy.en: Slow tempo: use roughly 3–4 seconds up and down to maximize time under tension.
decline-dumbbell-press-copy.tr: Yavaş tempo: gerilim altındaki süreyi artırmak için iniş ve çıkışı yaklaşık 3–4 saniye yap.
decline-dumbbell-press-copy.ar: إيقاع بطيء: خذ نحو 3–4 ثوانٍ صعودًا ونزولًا لزيادة زمن الشد.

dual-cable-side-laterals.en: Dual cable: use two pulleys with cables crossed to train both sides at once.
dual-cable-side-laterals.tr: Çift kablo: iki makarayı çapraz kablolarla kullanarak iki tarafı aynı anda çalıştır.
dual-cable-side-laterals.ar: كابلان: استخدم بكرتين مع تقاطع الكابلين لتدريب الجانبين معًا.

dual-cable-side-laterals-pronated-to-pal.en: Rotate the palms down as you rise to keep the side delt as the prime mover.
dual-cable-side-laterals-pronated-to-pal.tr: Kalkarken avuçları aşağı çevir; yan omuz ana çalışan kas olarak kalsın.
dual-cable-side-laterals-pronated-to-pal.ar: دوّر الراحتين للأسفل أثناء الرفع لتبقى الدالية الجانبية المحرك الأساسي.

dual-single-handle-wrist-curl.en: Use two single cable handles to train each wrist independently.
dual-single-handle-wrist-curl.tr: Her bileği ayrı çalıştırmak için iki tekli kablo tutamağı kullan.
dual-single-handle-wrist-curl.ar: استخدم مقبضين منفردين للكابل لتدريب كل رسغ بشكل مستقل.

dual-single-handle-wrist-extension.en: Use two single cable handles to train each wrist independently.
dual-single-handle-wrist-extension.tr: Her bileği ayrı çalıştırmak için iki tekli kablo tutamağı kullan.
dual-single-handle-wrist-extension.ar: استخدم مقبضين منفردين للكابل لتدريب كل رسغ بشكل مستقل.

dumbbell-shoulder-press-frontal-plane-hi.en: Frontal plane: elbows stay out to the sides in line with the torso for more side-delt work.
dumbbell-shoulder-press-frontal-plane-hi.tr: Frontal plane: dirsekler gövde hizasında yanlarda kalır; yan omuz daha çok çalışır.
dumbbell-shoulder-press-frontal-plane-hi.ar: المستوى الأمامي: يبقى المرفقان جانبًا على خط الجذع لعمل أكبر للدالية الجانبية.

dumbbell-shrug-extreme-stretch.en: Extreme stretch: lower deeper than usual to emphasize the loaded stretch, staying pain-free.
dumbbell-shrug-extreme-stretch.tr: Extreme stretch: yüklü gerilmeyi vurgulamak için normalden daha derine in, ağrısız kal.
dumbbell-shrug-extreme-stretch.ar: تمدد أقصى: انزل أعمق من المعتاد للتركيز على التمدد المحمّل دون ألم.

dumbbell-shrug-mechanical-drop-starting-.en: Mechanical drop: switch to a stronger body position at failure instead of lowering the weight.
dumbbell-shrug-mechanical-drop-starting-.tr: Mechanical drop: tükenişte ağırlığı azaltmak yerine daha güçlü bir pozisyona geç.
dumbbell-shrug-mechanical-drop-starting-.ar: Mechanical drop: عند الفشل انتقل إلى وضعية أقوى بدل تخفيف الوزن.

dumbbell-shrugs-copy.en: Wide grip: hands outside shoulder width, which feels natural for many and frees the shoulders.
dumbbell-shrugs-copy.tr: Geniş tutuş: eller omuz genişliğinin dışında; çoğu kişiye doğal gelir ve omuzları rahatlatır.
dumbbell-shrugs-copy.ar: قبضة واسعة: اليدان أوسع من الكتفين، وهي مريحة للكثيرين وتحرر حركة الكتف.

dumbbell-side-lateral-controlled-copy.en: Standing version: raise out to the sides, then continue overhead in a slow arc.
dumbbell-side-lateral-controlled-copy.tr: Ayakta versiyon: yanlara kaldır, sonra yavaş bir yayla baş üstüne devam et.
dumbbell-side-lateral-controlled-copy.ar: نسخة الوقوف: ارفع جانبًا ثم أكمل فوق الرأس في قوس بطيء.

dumbbell-side-lateral-copy.en: Single arm: train one side at a time for better focus and a stable torso.
dumbbell-side-lateral-copy.tr: Tek kol: daha iyi odak ve sabit gövde için her seferinde tek tarafı çalıştır.
dumbbell-side-lateral-copy.ar: ذراع واحدة: درّب جانبًا واحدًا في كل مرة لتركيز أفضل وجذع ثابت.

dumbbell-side-lateral-holds-garage-progr.en: Holds: pause and hold the arms near the top for a few seconds each rep.
dumbbell-side-lateral-holds-garage-progr.tr: Holds: her tekrarda kolları tepeye yakın birkaç saniye tut.
dumbbell-side-lateral-holds-garage-progr.ar: Holds: توقف وثبّت الذراعين قرب الأعلى بضع ثوانٍ في كل تكرار.

dumbbell-side-lateral-incline.en: Lying on an incline bench removes momentum and keeps tension in the stretched position.
dumbbell-side-lateral-incline.tr: Eğimli sehpaya uzanmak momentumu ortadan kaldırır ve gerilimi gerilmiş pozisyonda tutar.
dumbbell-side-lateral-incline.ar: الاستلقاء على مقعد مائل يلغي الزخم ويبقي الشد في وضع التمدد.

dumbbell-side-lateral-incline-copy.en: Seated: sitting removes leg drive and body swing.
dumbbell-side-lateral-incline-copy.tr: Oturarak: oturmak bacak itişini ve gövde salınımını ortadan kaldırır.
dumbbell-side-lateral-incline-copy.ar: جلوسًا: الجلوس يلغي دفع الساقين وأرجحة الجسم.

dumbbell-side-lateral-incline-copy-ryan_.en: Single arm: train one side at a time for better focus and a stable torso.
dumbbell-side-lateral-incline-copy-ryan_.tr: Tek kol: daha iyi odak ve sabit gövde için her seferinde tek tarafı çalıştır.
dumbbell-side-lateral-incline-copy-ryan_.ar: ذراع واحدة: درّب جانبًا واحدًا في كل مرة لتركيز أفضل وجذع ثابت.

dumbbell-side-lateral-lats-flared.en: Lats flared: keep the lats spread and arms slightly away from the body to keep tension on the side delt.
dumbbell-side-lateral-lats-flared.tr: Lats flared: latları açık, kolları vücuttan hafif uzak tut; gerilim yan omuzda kalsın.
dumbbell-side-lateral-lats-flared.ar: Lats flared: أبقِ الظهر العريض مفرودًا والذراعين بعيدتين قليلًا عن الجسم ليبقى الشد على الدالية الجانبية.

dumbbell-side-lateral-partials-garage-pr.en: Partials: work only the stretched lower half of the range, ideally after full-range reps fail.
dumbbell-side-lateral-partials-garage-pr.tr: Partials: sadece gerilmiş alt yarıda çalış, ideal olarak tam açıklık tükendikten sonra.
dumbbell-side-lateral-partials-garage-pr.ar: Partials: اعمل في النصف السفلي الممدود فقط، ويفضّل بعد الفشل في المدى الكامل.

dumbbell-side-laterals-fixed-elbow-garag.en: Fixed elbow: lock the elbow at about 90 degrees so the arm moves as one short lever.
dumbbell-side-laterals-fixed-elbow-garag.tr: Fixed elbow: dirseği yaklaşık 90 derecede sabitle; kol tek ve kısa bir kaldıraç gibi hareket etsin.
dumbbell-side-laterals-fixed-elbow-garag.ar: مرفق ثابت: ثبّت المرفق عند نحو 90 درجة لتتحرك الذراع كرافعة واحدة قصيرة.

dumbbell-side-laterals-scapular-plane-ga.en: Scapular plane: move about 30 degrees in front of the body, a natural, shoulder-friendly path.
dumbbell-side-laterals-scapular-plane-ga.tr: Scapular plane: vücudun yaklaşık 30 derece önünde hareket et; doğal ve omuz dostu bir yol.
dumbbell-side-laterals-scapular-plane-ga.ar: مستوى لوح الكتف: تحرك بزاوية نحو 30 درجة أمام الجسم، وهو مسار طبيعي ومريح للكتف.

dumbbell-side-laterals-straight-arm-gara.en: Straight arm: keep the elbow locked straight, making the lever longer and the load harder.
dumbbell-side-laterals-straight-arm-gara.tr: Düz kol: dirseği düz kilitli tut; kaldıraç uzar ve yük zorlaşır.
dumbbell-side-laterals-straight-arm-gara.ar: ذراع مستقيمة: أبقِ المرفق مستقيمًا فتطول الرافعة ويصعب الحمل.

ez-bar-drag-curls-garage-program-copy-ry.en: Reverse grip: palms face you throughout, keeping elbows forward and stressing the front delt.
ez-bar-drag-curls-garage-program-copy-ry.tr: Ters tutuş: avuçlar sürekli sana dönük; dirsekler önde kalır ve ön omuz vurgulanır.
ez-bar-drag-curls-garage-program-copy-ry.ar: قبضة عكسية: الراحتان نحوك طوال الحركة، فيبقى المرفقان أمامك ويُركَّز على الدالية الأمامية.

ez-bar-reverse-grip-curls-ryan_humis5147.en: EZ bar's angled grip reduces wrist strain.
ez-bar-reverse-grip-curls-ryan_humis5147.tr: EZ barın açılı tutuşu bilek yükünü azaltır.
ez-bar-reverse-grip-curls-ryan_humis5147.ar: القبضة المائلة لبار EZ تقلل الضغط على الرسغ.

high-incline-hybrid-front-side-lateral-r.en: Hybrid: raise between the front and side, training both the front and side delts.
high-incline-hybrid-front-side-lateral-r.tr: Hibrit: ön ile yan arasında bir açıda kaldır; ön ve yan omuz birlikte çalışır.
high-incline-hybrid-front-side-lateral-r.ar: هجين: ارفع بين الأمام والجانب لتدريب الدالية الأمامية والجانبية معًا.

incline-barbell-shoulder-press.en: Seated on a high-incline bench for back support and stability.
incline-barbell-shoulder-press.tr: Sırt desteği ve stabilite için yüksek eğimli sehpada oturarak yapılır.
incline-barbell-shoulder-press.ar: جلوسًا على مقعد بميل مرتفع لدعم الظهر والثبات.

incline-barbell-wide-grip-upright-row.en: Lie chest-down on an incline bench and row wide, removing hip drive.
incline-barbell-wide-grip-upright-row.tr: Eğimli sehpaya göğüs üstü uzan ve geniş çek; kalça itişini ortadan kaldırır.
incline-barbell-wide-grip-upright-row.ar: استلقِ على صدرك فوق مقعد مائل واسحب بقبضة واسعة لإلغاء دفع الوركين.

incline-cable-side-lateral.en: Lying on an incline bench removes momentum and keeps tension in the stretched position.
incline-cable-side-lateral.tr: Eğimli sehpaya uzanmak momentumu ortadan kaldırır ve gerilimi gerilmiş pozisyonda tutar.
incline-cable-side-lateral.ar: الاستلقاء على مقعد مائل يلغي الزخم ويبقي الشد في وضع التمدد.

incline-dumbbell-high-elbow-row-copy.en: Wide grip: hands outside shoulder width, which feels natural for many and frees the shoulders.
incline-dumbbell-high-elbow-row-copy.tr: Geniş tutuş: eller omuz genişliğinin dışında; çoğu kişiye doğal gelir ve omuzları rahatlatır.

incline-dumbbell-rear-delt-raise-copy.en: Single arm: train one side at a time for better focus and a stable torso.

incline-dumbbell-rear-delt-raise-copy.ar: ذراع واحدة: درّب جانبًا واحدًا في كل مرة لتركيز أفضل وجذع ثابت.

incline-dumbbell-rear-delt-raise-garage-.en: Lying on an incline bench removes momentum and keeps tension in the stretched position.
incline-dumbbell-rear-delt-raise-garage-.tr: Eğimli sehpaya uzanmak momentumu ortadan kaldırır ve gerilimi gerilmiş pozisyonda tutar.
incline-dumbbell-rear-delt-raise-garage-.ar: الاستلقاء على مقعد مائل يلغي الزخم ويبقي الشد في وضع التمدد.

incline-dumbbell-shoulder-press-scapular.en: Scapular plane with palms facing each other, a very joint-friendly press path.
incline-dumbbell-shoulder-press-scapular.tr: Avuçlar birbirine bakarken scapular plane'de; eklemlere çok dost bir press yolu.
incline-dumbbell-shoulder-press-scapular.ar: في مستوى لوح الكتف والراحتان متقابلتان، وهو مسار ضغط مريح جدًا للمفصل.

incline-dumbbell-shrug-45-degree-elbow.en: Flare the elbows about 45 degrees to bias the mid traps.
incline-dumbbell-shrug-45-degree-elbow.tr: Orta trapezi vurgulamak için dirsekleri yaklaşık 45 derece aç.
incline-dumbbell-shrug-45-degree-elbow.ar: افتح المرفقين نحو 45 درجة للتركيز على وسط شبه المنحرفة.

incline-dumbbell-side-lateral-facing-ben.en: Lie chest-down facing the bench with lats flared; this removes cheating and adds a stretch.
incline-dumbbell-side-lateral-facing-ben.tr: Latlar açık, yüzün sehpaya dönük göğüs üstü uzan; hileyi engeller ve gerilme ekler.
incline-dumbbell-side-lateral-facing-ben.ar: استلقِ على صدرك مواجهًا المقعد مع فرد الظهر العريض؛ هذا يمنع الغش ويزيد التمدد.

incline-dumbbell-side-lateral-garage-2-0.en: Lying on an incline bench removes momentum and keeps tension in the stretched position.
incline-dumbbell-side-lateral-garage-2-0.tr: Eğimli sehpaya uzanmak momentumu ortadan kaldırır ve gerilimi gerilmiş pozisyonda tutar.
incline-dumbbell-side-lateral-garage-2-0.ar: الاستلقاء على مقعد مائل يلغي الزخم ويبقي الشد في وضع التمدد.

incline-one-arm-shrug.en: Single arm: train one side at a time for better focus and a stable torso.
incline-one-arm-shrug.tr: Tek kol: daha iyi odak ve sabit gövde için her seferinde tek tarafı çalıştır.
incline-one-arm-shrug.ar: ذراع واحدة: درّب جانبًا واحدًا في كل مرة لتركيز أفضل وجذع ثابت.

incline-partial-rear-delt-raises-garage-.en: Partials: work only the stretched lower half of the range, ideally after full-range reps fail.
incline-partial-rear-delt-raises-garage-.tr: Partials: sadece gerilmiş alt yarıda çalış, ideal olarak tam açıklık tükendikten sonra.
incline-partial-rear-delt-raises-garage-.ar: Partials: اعمل في النصف السفلي الممدود فقط، ويفضّل بعد الفشل في المدى الكامل.

incline-shoulder-press-slightly-supinate.en: Slightly supinated grip: palms turned a bit toward you, easing shoulder stress.
incline-shoulder-press-slightly-supinate.tr: Hafif supinasyon tutuşu: avuçlar biraz sana dönük; omuz stresini azaltır.
incline-shoulder-press-slightly-supinate.ar: قبضة سفلية قليلًا: الراحتان مائلتان نحوك قليلًا لتخفيف الضغط على الكتف.

incline-straight-arm-rear-delt-partials.en: Straight-arm partials on an incline bench: elbows locked, reps in the stretched range.
incline-straight-arm-rear-delt-partials.tr: Eğimli sehpada düz kol partials: dirsekler kilitli, tekrarlar gerilmiş aralıkta.
incline-straight-arm-rear-delt-partials.ar: Partials بذراع مستقيمة على مقعد مائل: المرفقان مقفلان والتكرارات في المدى الممدود.

landmine-mid-trap-shrugs.en: Straddle or face a landmine bar for a stable, comfortable grip.
landmine-mid-trap-shrugs.tr: Stabil ve rahat tutuş için landmine barının üstüne ya da karşısına geç.
landmine-mid-trap-shrugs.ar: قف فوق بار اللاندماين أو مواجهًا له لقبضة ثابتة ومريحة.

landmine-rear-delt-raise.en: Low hand position: grip near the bar end for the longest lever and most stretch.
landmine-rear-delt-raise.tr: Alt el pozisyonu: en uzun kaldıraç ve en fazla gerilme için bar ucuna yakın tut.
landmine-rear-delt-raise.ar: وضع اليد المنخفض: أمسك قرب طرف البار لأطول رافعة وأكبر تمدد.

landmine-rear-delt-raise-2nd-position.en: Mid hand position: a balance between stretch and load at the top.
landmine-rear-delt-raise-2nd-position.tr: Orta el pozisyonu: gerilme ile tepedeki yük arasında denge.
landmine-rear-delt-raise-2nd-position.ar: وضع اليد المتوسط: توازن بين التمدد والحمل في الأعلى.

landmine-rear-delt-raise-high-hand-posit.en: High hand position: a shorter lever that lets you handle more load.
landmine-rear-delt-raise-high-hand-posit.tr: Üst el pozisyonu: daha kısa kaldıraç, daha fazla yük kaldırmanı sağlar.
landmine-rear-delt-raise-high-hand-posit.ar: وضع اليد المرتفع: رافعة أقصر تتيح لك حمل وزن أكبر.

leg-press-calf-raise-toes-out-copy.en: Cluster sets: do short mini-sets with 10–20 seconds rest to accumulate more hard reps.
leg-press-calf-raise-toes-out-copy.tr: Cluster set: 10–20 saniye dinlenmeli kısa mini setlerle daha fazla zorlu tekrar biriktir.
leg-press-calf-raise-toes-out-copy.ar: Cluster sets: نفّذ مجموعات صغيرة قصيرة مع راحة 10–20 ثانية لتجميع تكرارات صعبة أكثر.

lying-arnold-rotations-garage-program.en: Lying on a bench changes the resistance curve and removes momentum.
lying-arnold-rotations-garage-program.tr: Sehpaya uzanmak direnç eğrisini değiştirir ve momentumu kaldırır.
lying-arnold-rotations-garage-program.ar: الاستلقاء على مقعد يغيّر منحنى المقاومة ويلغي الزخم.

lying-dual-cable-side-lateral.en: Lying: lie on a flat bench between cables, which loads the delt hard at the bottom.
lying-dual-cable-side-lateral.tr: Lying: kablolar arasında düz sehpaya uzan; delt'i altta sert yükler.
lying-dual-cable-side-lateral.ar: استلقاءً: استلقِ على مقعد مستوٍ بين الكابلين، ما يحمّل الدالية بقوة في الأسفل.

lying-dumbbell-pronation.en: Lying with the arm supported removes shoulder cheating.
lying-dumbbell-pronation.tr: Kol destekliyken uzanmak omuzla hileyi ortadan kaldırır.
lying-dumbbell-pronation.ar: الاستلقاء مع دعم الذراع يمنع الغش بالكتف.

lying-incline-bus-drivers-garage-program.en: Lying on an incline bench (back supported) shifts load and removes body swing.
lying-incline-bus-drivers-garage-program.tr: Sırt destekli eğimli sehpaya uzanmak yükü değiştirir ve gövde salınımını önler.
lying-incline-bus-drivers-garage-program.ar: الاستلقاء على مقعد مائل (الظهر مدعوم) يغيّر توزيع الحمل ويمنع أرجحة الجسم.

lying-incline-dual-cable-side-lateral.en: Lying on an incline bench removes momentum and keeps tension in the stretched position.
lying-incline-dual-cable-side-lateral.tr: Eğimli sehpaya uzanmak momentumu ortadan kaldırır ve gerilimi gerilmiş pozisyonda tutar.
lying-incline-dual-cable-side-lateral.ar: الاستلقاء على مقعد مائل يلغي الزخم ويبقي الشد في وضع التمدد.

lying-rear-delt-flys-pronated-garage-pro.en: Lying chest-down with palms facing down (pronated) for strict rear-delt isolation.
lying-rear-delt-flys-pronated-garage-pro.tr: Katı arka omuz izolasyonu için avuçlar aşağı (pronasyon), göğüs üstü uzanarak.
lying-rear-delt-flys-pronated-garage-pro.ar: مستلقيًا على صدرك والراحتان للأسفل لعزل صارم للدالية الخلفية.

machine-rear-delt-fly-extended-partials.en: Extended partials: after failure, keep doing partial reps in the stretched half.
machine-rear-delt-fly-extended-partials.tr: Extended partials: tükenişten sonra gerilmiş yarıda yarım tekrarlarla devam et.
machine-rear-delt-fly-extended-partials.ar: Extended partials: بعد الفشل استمر بتكرارات جزئية في النصف الممدود.

machine-rear-delt-fly-high-hands.en: High hands: set handles higher so the arms travel above shoulder level, shifting load toward the rear delt.
machine-rear-delt-fly-high-hands.tr: Yüksek eller: tutamakları yüksek ayarla; kollar omuz üstünden geçer ve yük arka omza kayar.
machine-rear-delt-fly-high-hands.ar: يدان مرتفعتان: اضبط المقابض أعلى لتمر الذراعان فوق مستوى الكتف فيتجه الحمل نحو الدالية الخلفية.

machine-rear-delt-partials.en: Partials: work only the stretched lower half of the range, ideally after full-range reps fail.
machine-rear-delt-partials.tr: Partials: sadece gerilmiş alt yarıda çalış, ideal olarak tam açıklık tükendikten sonra.
machine-rear-delt-partials.ar: Partials: اعمل في النصف السفلي الممدود فقط، ويفضّل بعد الفشل في المدى الكامل.

machine-shoulder-press-extreme-stretch.en: Extreme stretch: lower deeper than usual to emphasize the loaded stretch, staying pain-free.
machine-shoulder-press-extreme-stretch.tr: Extreme stretch: yüklü gerilmeyi vurgulamak için normalden daha derine in, ağrısız kal.
machine-shoulder-press-extreme-stretch.ar: تمدد أقصى: انزل أعمق من المعتاد للتركيز على التمدد المحمّل دون ألم.

machine-shoulder-press-frontal-plane.en: Frontal plane: elbows stay out to the sides in line with the torso for more side-delt work.
machine-shoulder-press-frontal-plane.tr: Frontal plane: dirsekler gövde hizasında yanlarda kalır; yan omuz daha çok çalışır.
machine-shoulder-press-frontal-plane.ar: المستوى الأمامي: يبقى المرفقان جانبًا على خط الجذع لعمل أكبر للدالية الجانبية.

machine-shoulder-press-scapular-plane.en: Scapular plane: move about 30 degrees in front of the body, a natural, shoulder-friendly path.
machine-shoulder-press-scapular-plane.tr: Scapular plane: vücudun yaklaşık 30 derece önünde hareket et; doğal ve omuz dostu bir yol.
machine-shoulder-press-scapular-plane.ar: مستوى لوح الكتف: تحرك بزاوية نحو 30 درجة أمام الجسم، وهو مسار طبيعي ومريح للكتف.

machine-shrug-drops-last-drop-is-a-row.en: Drop set on a machine; on the final drop, switch to rows to finish the upper back.
machine-shrug-drops-last-drop-is-a-row.tr: Makinede drop set; son düşüşte üst sırtı bitirmek için row'a geç.
machine-shrug-drops-last-drop-is-a-row.ar: drop set على الجهاز؛ وفي آخر تخفيف انتقل للتجديف لإنهاء أعلى الظهر.

machine-side-laterals-straight-arm-parti.en: Straight-arm partials on the machine: arms locked, reps in the stretched lower range.
machine-side-laterals-straight-arm-parti.tr: Makinede düz kol partials: kollar kilitli, tekrarlar alttaki gerilmiş aralıkta.
machine-side-laterals-straight-arm-parti.ar: Partials بذراع مستقيمة على الجهاز: الذراعان مقفلتان والتكرارات في المدى السفلي الممدود.

machine-single-arm-rear-delt-fly-copy-ry.en: Lying chest-down, row the cable with high elbows to remove momentum.
machine-single-arm-rear-delt-fly-copy-ry.tr: Göğüs üstü uzanarak, momentumu kaldırmak için kabloyu yüksek dirseklerle çek.
machine-single-arm-rear-delt-fly-copy-ry.ar: مستلقيًا على صدرك، اسحب الكابل بمرفقين مرتفعين لإلغاء الزخم.

machine-t-bar-high-elbow-shrugs.en: Chest-supported T-bar machine removes lower-back strain.
machine-t-bar-high-elbow-shrugs.tr: Göğüs destekli T-bar makinesi bel yükünü ortadan kaldırır.
machine-t-bar-high-elbow-shrugs.ar: جهاز T-bar بدعم للصدر يزيل الضغط عن أسفل الظهر.

mid-grip-pull-up-shrugs-weighted.en: Weighted, shoulder-width grip; add load with a belt or dumbbell.
mid-grip-pull-up-shrugs-weighted.tr: Ağırlıklı, omuz genişliğinde tutuş; kemer ya da dumbbell ile yük ekle.
mid-grip-pull-up-shrugs-weighted.ar: مع وزن وقبضة بعرض الكتفين؛ أضف الحمل بحزام أو دمبل.

modified-arnold-press-ryan_humis514743.en: Modified Arnold: start palms in front and rotate out as you press, adding front-delt range.
modified-arnold-press-ryan_humis514743.tr: Modified Arnold: avuçlar önde başla, iterken dışa döndür; ön omuza açıklık ekler.
modified-arnold-press-ryan_humis514743.ar: Arnold معدّل: ابدأ والراحتان نحوك ودوّرهما للخارج أثناء الضغط لزيادة مدى الدالية الأمامية.

partial-sides-pre-exhaust-garage-program.en: Pre-exhaust: do partial lateral raises first to fatigue the side delts before presses.
partial-sides-pre-exhaust-garage-program.tr: Pre-exhaust: press'ten önce yan omzu yormak için önce yarım lateral raise yap.
partial-sides-pre-exhaust-garage-program.ar: إجهاد مسبق: نفّذ رفعات جانبية جزئية أولًا لإجهاد الدالية الجانبية قبل الضغط.

pendlay-row-copy.en: Seated with drop sets: reduce the weight at failure and continue without rest.
pendlay-row-copy.tr: Oturarak drop set: tükenişte ağırlığı azalt ve dinlenmeden devam et.
pendlay-row-copy.ar: جلوسًا مع drop set: خفّف الوزن عند الفشل واستمر دون راحة.

pinwheel-drag.en: Neutral (hammer) grip with dumbbells, dragged across or up the body.
pinwheel-drag.tr: Dumbbell'larla nötr (hammer) tutuş; vücut boyunca ya da çapraz sürüklenir.
pinwheel-drag.ar: قبضة محايدة (hammer) بالدمبلز مع سحبها على امتداد الجسم أو عرضيًا.

plate-supinated-raise-garage-2-0.en: Hold a plate with palms up; the supinated grip emphasizes the front delt and biceps.
plate-supinated-raise-garage-2-0.tr: Plakayı avuçlar yukarı tut; supinasyon tutuşu ön omzu ve biceps'i vurgular.
plate-supinated-raise-garage-2-0.ar: أمسك القرص والراحتان للأعلى؛ القبضة السفلية تبرز الدالية الأمامية والبايسبس.

poor-mans-viking-press.en: Improvised version: press a landmine bar end with both hands if no Viking handle exists.
poor-mans-viking-press.tr: Doğaçlama versiyon: Viking tutamağı yoksa landmine bar ucunu iki elle it.
poor-mans-viking-press.ar: نسخة مرتجلة: اضغط طرف بار اللاندماين بكلتا اليدين إن لم يتوفر مقبض Viking.

rear-delt-behind-the-back-barbell-raise-.en: Partials: work only the stretched lower half of the range, ideally after full-range reps fail.
rear-delt-behind-the-back-barbell-raise-.tr: Partials: sadece gerilmiş alt yarıda çalış, ideal olarak tam açıklık tükendikten sonra.
rear-delt-behind-the-back-barbell-raise-.ar: Partials: اعمل في النصف السفلي الممدود فقط، ويفضّل بعد الفشل في المدى الكامل.

rear-delt-fly-buffet-bottom-garage-progr.en: Buffet (bottom): do partial reps in the lower, stretched portion of the range.
rear-delt-fly-buffet-bottom-garage-progr.tr: Buffet (alt): hareketin alt, gerilmiş kısmında yarım tekrarlar yap.
rear-delt-fly-buffet-bottom-garage-progr.ar: Buffet (الأسفل): نفّذ تكرارات جزئية في الجزء السفلي الممدود من المدى.

rear-delt-fly-buffet-full-rom-garage-pro.en: Buffet (full ROM): finish the sequence with full-range reps.
rear-delt-fly-buffet-full-rom-garage-pro.tr: Buffet (tam açıklık): seriyi tam hareket açıklığıyla tamamla.
rear-delt-fly-buffet-full-rom-garage-pro.ar: Buffet (المدى الكامل): أكمل السلسلة بتكرارات بالمدى الكامل.

rear-delt-fly-buffet-top-garage-program.en: Buffet (top): do partial reps in the upper, contracted portion of the range.
rear-delt-fly-buffet-top-garage-program.tr: Buffet (üst): hareketin üst, kasılmış kısmında yarım tekrarlar yap.
rear-delt-fly-buffet-top-garage-program.ar: Buffet (الأعلى): نفّذ تكرارات جزئية في الجزء العلوي المنقبض من المدى.

reverse-grip-shoulder-press-garage-progr.en: Sit on a high-incline bench with back support to stop momentum.
reverse-grip-shoulder-press-garage-progr.tr: Momentumu önlemek için sırt destekli yüksek eğimli sehpaya otur.
reverse-grip-shoulder-press-garage-progr.ar: اجلس على مقعد بميل مرتفع مع دعم للظهر لمنع الزخم.

seated-angled-barbell-wrist-curls.en: Angle the forearms down off the knees for a deeper stretch.
seated-angled-barbell-wrist-curls.tr: Daha derin gerilme için ön kolları dizlerden aşağı açılı yerleştir.
seated-angled-barbell-wrist-curls.ar: اجعل الساعدين مائلين للأسفل عن الركبتين لتمدد أعمق.

seated-bus-driver-garage-program.en: Seated: removes leg drive, keeping the work on the front delts.
seated-bus-driver-garage-program.tr: Oturarak: bacak itişini kaldırır, iş ön omuzda kalır.
seated-bus-driver-garage-program.ar: جلوسًا: يلغي دفع الساقين ويبقي العمل على الدالية الأمامية.

seated-cable-reverse-grip-wrist-extensio.en: Seated cable with overhand grip for constant tension.
seated-cable-reverse-grip-wrist-extensio.tr: Sürekli gerilim için üstten tutuşla oturarak kablo.
seated-cable-reverse-grip-wrist-extensio.ar: كابل جلوسًا بقبضة علوية لشد مستمر.

seated-cable-shrugs.en: Seated cable: constant tension and a stable base.
seated-cable-shrugs.tr: Oturarak kablo: sürekli gerilim ve stabil bir zemin.
seated-cable-shrugs.ar: كابل جلوسًا: شد مستمر وقاعدة ثابتة.

seated-high-elbow-shrug.en: Cable version gives constant tension at the stretch.
seated-high-elbow-shrug.tr: Kablo versiyonu gerilmede sürekli gerilim sağlar.
seated-high-elbow-shrug.ar: نسخة الكابل تمنح شدًا مستمرًا في وضع التمدد.

seated-high-incline-rear-delt-cable-fly-.en: Seated on a high incline facing the bench, arms sweeping back close to the body.
seated-high-incline-rear-delt-cable-fly-.tr: Sehpaya dönük yüksek eğimde oturarak, kollar vücuda yakın geriye süpürülür.
seated-high-incline-rear-delt-cable-fly-.ar: جلوسًا على ميل مرتفع مواجهًا المقعد، والذراعان تتحركان للخلف قرب الجسم.

seated-one-arm-shrug.en: Single arm: train one side at a time for better focus and a stable torso.
seated-one-arm-shrug.tr: Tek kol: daha iyi odak ve sabit gövde için her seferinde tek tarafı çalıştır.
seated-one-arm-shrug.ar: ذراع واحدة: درّب جانبًا واحدًا في كل مرة لتركيز أفضل وجذع ثابت.

seated-rear-delt-close-to-body-raise.en: Seated, sweep the arms back low and close to the body for a longer rear-delt range.
seated-rear-delt-close-to-body-raise.tr: Oturarak kolları alçaktan ve vücuda yakın geriye süpür; arka omuz açıklığı uzar.
seated-rear-delt-close-to-body-raise.ar: جلوسًا، حرّك الذراعين للخلف منخفضتين وقريبتين من الجسم لمدى أطول للدالية الخلفية.

seated-rear-delt-partial-raise.en: Partials: work only the stretched lower half of the range, ideally after full-range reps fail.
seated-rear-delt-partial-raise.tr: Partials: sadece gerilmiş alt yarıda çalış, ideal olarak tam açıklık tükendikten sonra.
seated-rear-delt-partial-raise.ar: Partials: اعمل في النصف السفلي الممدود فقط، ويفضّل بعد الفشل في المدى الكامل.

seated-supinated-shrugs-garage-program.en: Palms facing forward (supinated) while seated; some lifters feel the traps better this way.
seated-supinated-shrugs-garage-program.tr: Oturarak avuçlar öne dönük (supinasyon); bazıları trapezi böyle daha iyi hisseder.
seated-supinated-shrugs-garage-program.ar: جلوسًا والراحتان للأمام (قبضة سفلية)؛ يشعر بعض المتدربين بشبه المنحرفة أفضل هكذا.

side-lateral-buffet-bottom-garage-progra.en: Buffet (bottom): do partial reps in the lower, stretched portion of the range.
side-lateral-buffet-bottom-garage-progra.tr: Buffet (alt): hareketin alt, gerilmiş kısmında yarım tekrarlar yap.
side-lateral-buffet-bottom-garage-progra.ar: Buffet (الأسفل): نفّذ تكرارات جزئية في الجزء السفلي الممدود من المدى.

side-lateral-buffet-full-rom-garage-prog.en: Buffet (full ROM): finish the sequence with full-range reps.
side-lateral-buffet-full-rom-garage-prog.tr: Buffet (tam açıklık): seriyi tam hareket açıklığıyla tamamla.
side-lateral-buffet-full-rom-garage-prog.ar: Buffet (المدى الكامل): أكمل السلسلة بتكرارات بالمدى الكامل.

side-lateral-buffet-top-garage-program.en: Buffet (top): do partial reps in the upper, contracted portion of the range.
side-lateral-buffet-top-garage-program.tr: Buffet (üst): hareketin üst, kasılmış kısmında yarım tekrarlar yap.
side-lateral-buffet-top-garage-program.ar: Buffet (الأعلى): نفّذ تكرارات جزئية في الجزء العلوي المنقبض من المدى.

side-laterals-fixed-elbow.en: Fixed elbow: lock the elbow at about 90 degrees so the arm moves as one short lever.
side-laterals-fixed-elbow.tr: Fixed elbow: dirseği yaklaşık 90 derecede sabitle; kol tek ve kısa bir kaldıraç gibi hareket etsin.
side-laterals-fixed-elbow.ar: مرفق ثابت: ثبّت المرفق عند نحو 90 درجة لتتحرك الذراع كرافعة واحدة قصيرة.

single-arm-bench-stabilized-dumbbell-sid.en: Hold a bench with the free hand to lock the torso and isolate the side delt.
single-arm-bench-stabilized-dumbbell-sid.tr: Torsoyu sabitlemek ve yan omzu izole etmek için boştaki elinle sehpayı tut.
single-arm-bench-stabilized-dumbbell-sid.ar: أمسك المقعد باليد الحرة لتثبيت الجذع وعزل الدالية الجانبية.

single-arm-cable-rear-delt-copy.en: Arms close to body: keep the cable path low beside the torso for a deep stretch.
single-arm-cable-rear-delt-copy.tr: Kollar vücuda yakın: derin gerilme için kablo yolunu gövdenin yanında alçak tut.
single-arm-cable-rear-delt-copy.ar: الذراعان قرب الجسم: أبقِ مسار الكابل منخفضًا بجانب الجذع لتمدد عميق.

single-arm-cable-rear-delt-partials-copy.en: Single arm: train one side at a time for better focus and a stable torso.
single-arm-cable-rear-delt-partials-copy.tr: Tek kol: daha iyi odak ve sabit gövde için her seferinde tek tarafı çalıştır.
single-arm-cable-rear-delt-partials-copy.ar: ذراع واحدة: درّب جانبًا واحدًا في كل مرة لتركيز أفضل وجذع ثابت.

single-arm-dumbbell-rear-delt-raise-copy.en: Single arm: train one side at a time for better focus and a stable torso.
single-arm-dumbbell-rear-delt-raise-copy.tr: Tek kol: daha iyi odak ve sabit gövde için her seferinde tek tarafı çalıştır.
single-arm-dumbbell-rear-delt-raise-copy.ar: ذراع واحدة: درّب جانبًا واحدًا في كل مرة لتركيز أفضل وجذع ثابت.

single-arm-dumbbell-side-lateral-control.en: Single arm, controlled: one side at a time with a slow, strict tempo.
single-arm-dumbbell-side-lateral-control.tr: Tek kol, kontrollü: her seferinde tek taraf, yavaş ve katı tempo.
single-arm-dumbbell-side-lateral-control.ar: ذراع واحدة بتحكم: جانب واحد في كل مرة بإيقاع بطيء وصارم.

single-arm-machine-rear-delt-fly-exagger.en: Single arm, reaching across the body at the bottom for an exaggerated stretch.
single-arm-machine-rear-delt-fly-exagger.tr: Tek kol; altta vücudun önünden uzanarak abartılı bir gerilme sağla.
single-arm-machine-rear-delt-fly-exagger.ar: ذراع واحدة مع مدّها عبر الجسم في الأسفل لتمدد مبالغ فيه.

single-arm-machine-shoulder-press-ryan_h.en: Single arm: train one side at a time for better focus and a stable torso.
single-arm-machine-shoulder-press-ryan_h.tr: Tek kol: daha iyi odak ve sabit gövde için her seferinde tek tarafı çalıştır.
single-arm-machine-shoulder-press-ryan_h.ar: ذراع واحدة: درّب جانبًا واحدًا في كل مرة لتركيز أفضل وجذع ثابت.

single-arm-rear-delt-db-raises.en: Single arm: train one side at a time for better focus and a stable torso.
single-arm-rear-delt-db-raises.tr: Tek kol: daha iyi odak ve sabit gövde için her seferinde tek tarafı çalıştır.
single-arm-rear-delt-db-raises.ar: ذراع واحدة: درّب جانبًا واحدًا في كل مرة لتركيز أفضل وجذع ثابت.

single-arm-side-lateral-machine-rear-del.en: Use a lateral raise machine facing the pad, one arm at a time, to train the rear delt.
single-arm-side-lateral-machine-rear-del.tr: Arka omzu çalıştırmak için lateral raise makinesine yüzün pede dönük, tek kolla otur.
single-arm-side-lateral-machine-rear-del.ar: استخدم جهاز الرفع الجانبي مواجهًا المسند وبذراع واحدة لتدريب الدالية الخلفية.

slight-incline-cable-straight-bar-revers.en: Lie back on a slight incline facing away from the cable for extra stretch.
slight-incline-cable-straight-bar-revers.tr: Ekstra gerilme için kabloya sırtın dönük, hafif eğimli sehpaya uzan.
slight-incline-cable-straight-bar-revers.ar: استلقِ على مقعد مائل قليلًا ظهرك للكابل لتمدد إضافي.

slight-incline-rear-delt-fixed-elbow-rot.en: Elbows fixed at 90 degrees on a slight incline; rotate the forearms up to hit rear delts and rotator cuff.
slight-incline-rear-delt-fixed-elbow-rot.tr: Hafif eğimde dirsekler 90 derecede sabit; ön kolları yukarı döndürerek arka omuz ve rotator cuff'ı çalıştır.
slight-incline-rear-delt-fixed-elbow-rot.ar: المرفقان ثابتان عند 90 درجة على ميل خفيف؛ دوّر الساعدين للأعلى لتشغيل الدالية الخلفية والكفة المدورة.

slight-incline-rear-delt-raise.en: Slight incline partials: lie on a low incline and work the stretched part of the range.
slight-incline-rear-delt-raise.tr: Hafif eğim partials: düşük eğimli sehpaya uzan, hareketin gerilmiş kısmında çalış.
slight-incline-rear-delt-raise.ar: Partials على ميل خفيف: استلقِ على مقعد منخفض الميل واعمل في الجزء الممدود.

slightly-bent-dumbbell-shrugs.en: Only a slight forward lean, between a standing and a bent shrug.
slightly-bent-dumbbell-shrugs.tr: Sadece hafif öne eğilme; ayakta ile eğik shrug arası.
slightly-bent-dumbbell-shrugs.ar: ميل خفيف للأمام فقط، بين الشراغ وقوفًا والشراغ منحنيًا.

slow-motion-side-laterals-thumbs-up-gara.en: Super slow with thumbs pointing up, a slightly more front-delt-friendly hand position.
slow-motion-side-laterals-thumbs-up-gara.tr: Başparmaklar yukarı bakacak şekilde süper yavaş; ön omza biraz daha yakın bir el pozisyonu.
slow-motion-side-laterals-thumbs-up-gara.ar: بطء شديد مع توجيه الإبهامين للأعلى، وهو وضع يد يُشرك الدالية الأمامية قليلًا.

smith-bent-over-mid-trap-shrugs.en: Smith machine: the fixed path lets you focus purely on squeezing.
smith-bent-over-mid-trap-shrugs.tr: Smith machine: sabit yol sadece sıkmaya odaklanmanı sağlar.
smith-bent-over-mid-trap-shrugs.ar: جهاز السميث: المسار الثابت يتيح التركيز على العصر فقط.

smith-shoulder-press-65-degree-scapular-.en: Set the bench to about 60 degrees and keep elbows in the scapular plane.
smith-shoulder-press-65-degree-scapular-.tr: Sehpayı yaklaşık 60 dereceye ayarla, dirsekleri scapular plane'de tut.
smith-shoulder-press-65-degree-scapular-.ar: اضبط المقعد على نحو 60 درجة وأبقِ المرفقين في مستوى لوح الكتف.

smith-wide-grip-upright-row.en: Smith machine: the fixed bar path lets you focus purely on the delts.
smith-wide-grip-upright-row.tr: Smith machine: sabit bar yolu sadece omuzlara odaklanmanı sağlar.
smith-wide-grip-upright-row.ar: جهاز السميث: مسار البار الثابت يتيح التركيز على الكتفين فقط.

standing-dumbbell-straight-arm-partials.en: Straight-arm partials: elbows locked, reps only in the lower stretched range.
standing-dumbbell-straight-arm-partials.tr: Düz kol partials: dirsekler kilitli, tekrarlar sadece alttaki gerilmiş aralıkta.
standing-dumbbell-straight-arm-partials.ar: Partials بذراع مستقيمة: المرفقان مقفلان والتكرارات في المدى السفلي الممدود فقط.

strap-attachment-pronators.en: Cable strap attachment gives constant tension through the rotation.
strap-attachment-pronators.tr: Kablo kayış aparatı dönüş boyunca sürekli gerilim sağlar.
strap-attachment-pronators.ar: ملحق الحزام بالكابل يمنح شدًا مستمرًا طوال الدوران.

strap-attachment-supinator.en: Cable strap attachment gives constant tension through the rotation.
strap-attachment-supinator.tr: Kablo kayış aparatı dönüş boyunca sürekli gerilim sağlar.
strap-attachment-supinator.ar: ملحق الحزام بالكابل يمنح شدًا مستمرًا طوال الدوران.

supinated-barbell-front-raise-clusterfuc.en: Done lying chest-down on an incline bench so the torso cannot cheat.
supinated-barbell-front-raise-clusterfuc.tr: Gövde hile yapamasın diye eğimli sehpaya göğüs üstü uzanarak yapılır.
supinated-barbell-front-raise-clusterfuc.ar: تُنفّذ مستلقيًا على صدرك فوق مقعد مائل فلا يستطيع الجذع الغش.

supinated-barbell-front-raise-clusterfuc.en: Fixed elbow + cluster: elbows locked at 90 degrees, done in short mini-sets with brief rests.
supinated-barbell-front-raise-clusterfuc.tr: Fixed elbow + cluster: dirsekler 90 derecede sabit, kısa dinlenmeli mini setlerle yapılır.
supinated-barbell-front-raise-clusterfuc.ar: مرفق ثابت + cluster: المرفقان مثبتان عند 90 درجة مع مجموعات صغيرة وراحات قصيرة.

trx-rear-delt-pull-separate.en: TRX: pull with high elbows, then spread the arms wide at the top.
trx-rear-delt-pull-separate.tr: TRX: yüksek dirseklerle çek, sonra tepede kolları geniş aç.
trx-rear-delt-pull-separate.ar: TRX: اسحب بمرفقين مرتفعين ثم افتح الذراعين على اتساعهما في الأعلى.

trx-y-raise-ryan_humis514743.en: TRX: lean back on the straps and pull yourself up into a Y; walk feet forward to add difficulty.
trx-y-raise-ryan_humis514743.tr: TRX: kayışlarda geriye yaslan ve kendini Y şeklinde çek; zorlaştırmak için ayakları öne al.
trx-y-raise-ryan_humis514743.ar: TRX: مِل للخلف على الأحزمة واسحب نفسك على شكل Y، وقدّم قدميك لزيادة الصعوبة.

v-bar-lat-shrugs.en: Close neutral grip on a V-bar; think of driving the elbows toward your hips to feel the lats.
v-bar-lat-shrugs.tr: V-bar'da dar nötr tutuş; latları hissetmek için dirsekleri kalçaya doğru sürmeyi düşün.
v-bar-lat-shrugs.ar: قبضة محايدة ضيقة على مقبض V؛ فكّر في دفع المرفقين نحو الوركين لتشعر بالظهر العريض.

v-bar-low-trap-shrugs.en: Lean back slightly and drive the shoulder blades down to bias the lower traps.
v-bar-low-trap-shrugs.tr: Hafif geriye yaslan ve alt trapezi vurgulamak için kürek kemiklerini aşağı it.
v-bar-low-trap-shrugs.ar: مِل للخلف قليلًا وادفع لوحي الكتف للأسفل للتركيز على أسفل شبه المنحرفة.

v-bar-pull-up-shrugs.en: Hang from a V-bar with a close neutral grip.
v-bar-pull-up-shrugs.ar: تعلّق بمقبض V بقبضة محايدة ضيقة.

viking-press-neutral-grip.en: Neutral grip: palms facing each other for a more shoulder-friendly press.
viking-press-neutral-grip.tr: Nötr tutuş: avuçlar birbirine bakar; daha omuz dostu bir press.
viking-press-neutral-grip.ar: قبضة محايدة: الراحتان متقابلتان لضغط أكثر راحة للكتف.

weighted-straight-hyper-drop-finish-copy.en: Focus on pulling the shoulders down to bias the lower traps.
weighted-straight-hyper-drop-finish-copy.tr: Alt trapezi vurgulamak için omuzları aşağı çekmeye odaklan.
weighted-straight-hyper-drop-finish-copy.ar: ركّز على سحب الكتفين للأسفل للتركيز على أسفل شبه المنحرفة.

wide-grip-pull-up-shrugs-weighted.en: Weighted, wide grip; add load with a belt or dumbbell.
wide-grip-pull-up-shrugs-weighted.tr: Ağırlıklı, geniş tutuş; kemer ya da dumbbell ile yük ekle.
wide-grip-pull-up-shrugs-weighted.ar: مع وزن وقبضة واسعة؛ أضف الحمل بحزام أو دمبل.

wide-grip-smith-upright-row.en: Smith machine: the fixed bar path lets you focus purely on the delts.
wide-grip-smith-upright-row.tr: Smith machine: sabit bar yolu sadece omuzlara odaklanmanı sağlar.
wide-grip-smith-upright-row.ar: جهاز السميث: مسار البار الثابت يتيح التركيز على الكتفين فقط.
